description:
Navigate to the Categorization activity in GCompris and complete the first level of the animals sorting exercise. 

Starting from the main menu:
1. Click on the 'Discovery' section (look for the lightbulb or magnifying glass icon).
2. Find and open the 'Categorization' activity (icon showing items being sorted into groups).
3. Select the 'Animals' category if prompted.
4. Drag each animal image into its correct category box (e.g., matching the habitat or type shown).
5. Continue until all items are sorted and the congratulations/bonus animation appears.

Do not close the application after completion.
